About this property

Comfortable Accommodations: Around Stays-Heaven And Harmony in Rishikesh offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and free WiFi. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and wardrobe, ensuring a pleasant stay. Convenient Facilities: Guests can enjoy a lounge, 24-hour front desk, concierge service, daily housekeeping, and a games room. Additional amenities include free on-site private parking, bicycle parking, and a tour desk. Prime Location: Located 18 km from Dehradun Airport, the hotel provides easy access to local attractions. Nearby activities include rafting, hiking, and yoga, catering to various interests.

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.7 for a two-person trip.
